name: integer_boundary_exhaustive
purpose: Exhaust every 23-bit signed accumulator pattern for all three layer-boundary casts: 25165824 cases. Prove nearest-even rounding and AP_SAT including negative half ties and both saturation limits.
changes: Independent testbench under exp/tb comparing the E048 integer primitive to real AMD ap_fixed. No original testbench or threshold changes.
interpretation: This verifies cast semantics over the entire representable accumulator domain; E048 independently verifies complete spatial and stream arithmetic on butterfly. It does not establish network hardware feasibility.
conclusion: Use exact raw-integer boundary logic only if all cases match.
notes: primitive validation only; no network latency or PSNR claimed
